Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2.  The petitioner has moved before this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail instituted under Sections 406, 420, 465, 467, 468, 469 & 471 of the I.P.C.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
It has further been submitted that the complainant/informant has filed this case only to avoid the liability toward the petitioner.
4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

Having regard to the facts of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Jamshedpur in connection with Sakchi P.S. Case No. 237/2024 with the condition that he will co- operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhaar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the 1|Page Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Having regard to the facts of the case, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Jamshedpur in connection with Sakchi P.S. Case No. 237/2024 with the condition that he will co- operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhaar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the 1|Page Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
It is made clear that if the petitioner does not cooperate with the investigation/trial, the State would be at liberty to take appropriate action.
